cases.prompt: Design the first-run journey for our team expense tool. Core value action: an employee files a first expense and sees it approved. Unavoidable setup: a new administrator must connect a bank feed before anyone can file an expense. Finance wants seven profile fields collected at signup (job title, department, cost center, manager, employee ID, phone, home currency). Audience: finance administrators at 20 to 200 person companies, most of whom have used another expense tool. Funnel evidence: 41% of new admins abandon at the bank-feed step, and the median admin takes 3 days to invite the first employee.
sourceAnchors: activation moment is the first action

cases.prompt: Our project tool routes every new user through the workspace creation wizard, including people who arrive via an invite link into an existing workspace. Core value action: completing a first task on a shared board. Unavoidable setup for a creator: name the workspace and create one board; an invited member needs none, because the workspace already exists. Audience: small product teams, familiar with tools like Trello. Funnel evidence: 34% of invited members quit inside the creation wizard, against 12% of creators. Design the first-run journey.
sourceAnchors: strongest evidence of correlation with early retention

forbiddenActions: route invited users through workspace creation
